gl:definition.gl:content: identifier which is guaranteed to be unique among all identifiers used for those objects and for a specific purpose

gl:notes.gl:content: A unique identifier refers to unique product identifier (3.1.25), unique economic operator identifier (3.1.22), and unique facility identifier (3.1.23).

gl:source.gl:modification: EN 18219:2026 replaces “identifier” with “string of characters that is required to be unique among all identifiers used for all objects for a specific purpose”; Note 1 to entry removed and a new Note 1 to entry added.
